question: For root bracket 1 and the two punctured real lambda boxes, can the actual plus-recessive raw-C solution normalized by u_lambda(4)=A_lambda(4)^(-1/4) be enclosed all the way to Q=-infinity, yielding a finite outward interval for the declared Gamma_1 without using an uncertified floating-point ODE solve?

pins root bracket 1 and supplies the exact lambda=0 Bessel regression family
pins the selected fixed-reference Gamma_1 identity and minus-tail convention

primary_sources.source: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 2.7(iii), Liouville--Green Approximation Theorem, equations 2.7.23--2.7.25

primary_sources.not_used_for: transport across the turning or oscillatory region, a narrow endpoint value, a zero of Gamma_1, a spectral measure or RAQ

declared_conventions.plus_normalization: For each fixed real (kappa,lambda), rescale the actual DLMF recessive solution so u_lambda(4)=A_lambda(4)^(-1/4)>0; this fixes amplitude and leaves its logarithmic derivative unchanged.
declared_conventions.riccati_frame: r=-u_Q/u and rho=r-x-1/2, used only on x>=3 where the barrier proves rho in [-1,1] and u>0
declared_conventions.compact_transport: Below x=3 use Z=(u,u_Q/kappa_min) and an outward matrix infinity-norm Gronwall envelope; this is analytic interval transport, not a numerical validated-ODE solver.
declared_conventions.minus_tail: For Q<=-4 use the free-rotation frame (u,u_Q/kappa), variation of constants and integrable potential/forcing norms to enclose the infinite tail directly.
declared_conventions.execution: exact SymPy identities plus python-flint 0.9.0 Arb/acb outward balls; no floating-point ODE solve, root solve, quadrature, finite difference or sampling grid

assumptions: Every statement is uniform only over the full inherited root bracket 1 and one displayed lambda box at a time; uniqueness of the lambda=0 root is not assumed.
The upstream Liouville--Green theorem is used to select the actual recessive solution direction. Rescaling it at Q=4 fixes amplitude but does not replace it with the WKB proxy.
The rho barrier is used only on x>=3. The later compact two-state bound remains valid through nodes and does not assume a sign for u.
The compact Gronwall enclosure is intentionally coarse. Finite outward enclosure, agreement of precision tiers and a closed infinite-tail remainder are success criteria; exclusion of zero is not.
The selected c_p and Gamma_1 convention is inherited verbatim. No other self-adjoint extension, p-mixing choice, spectral density, rigging map or physical interpretation is inferred.
